raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, v2 collector rows carry UTC txn_ts while legacy rows carry America/Chicago local time. The v2 rows therefore sit 6 hours ahead (CST in January). Evening v2 transactions land at 00:00-06:00 and on the next calendar date, which also drops rows from 2026-01-18 and inflates the 2026-01-19 anomalies. Normalizing v2 timestamps to Chicago local time restores the correct txn_ts and txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
